top.title: Nasdaq Resumes Selloff as Nvidia, Anthropic Shares Slump
top.summary: Tech stocks stumbled again, as fears around the AI trade crept back in a day after Jensen Huang’s return at Nvidia sparked the best day for U.S. stocks since April 2025.

top.title: China Takes Down Shanghai Party Boss Once Seen as Potential Leader
top.summary: Chen Jining, the party secretary of Shanghai, has been placed under investigation on suspicion of severe violations of party discipline and state laws.

top.title: Gold Futures Give Back Gains Following Nvidia-Driven Rally
top.summary: Gold gave back a chunk of the previous session’s Nvidia-fueled gains as the market turned its attention back to inflation and the outlook for Fed interest-rates.

top.title: Dollar Could Rise Further in 2027 if Fed Lifts Rates
top.summary: The DXY dollar index fell after hitting a 20-month high. The dollar could strengthen in 2027 as the Federal Reserve looks set to deliver more interest-rate hikes, J.P. Morgan analysts said.

top.title: Consumer confidence shoots up after Democrats' midterm victories — though inflation worries persist
top.summary: The Conference Board survey released Tuesday showed improvement across the board, with the headline confidence index jumping to 103.3.

top.title: Bitcoin slides amid US tariff nerves as Anthropic falls below IPO price
top.summary: Bitcoin gave up gains above $60,000 as tariff concerns weighed on US stocks and Anthropic shares hit new lows below $76.
